verdict.rationale: Firecrawl markets itself as handling scraping without 'proxy headaches' and covering 96% of the web (gh-8), implying built-in anti-bot/proxy handling, but no docs ever mention premium residential or datacenter proxy options, and a hands-on community comment explicitly states Firecrawl 'don't have proxy service which is the heart of any crawler and scraper' (comm-3), directly contradicting the implied anti-bot capability. missing for 10: explicit documentation of premium residential/datacenter proxy selection, first-party proxy infrastructure details, and independent confirmation that proxy-based bypass actually works.
